subject: Chemistry
q: What are the first ionization energies, in kJ mol⁻¹, of Na, Mg, Al and Si, respectively?
hint: Across period 3 the general rise has an exception between Mg and Al because Al loses a 3p electron.
solution: The measured values are Na = 496, Mg = 737, Al = 577 and Si = 786 kJ mol⁻¹. Although ionization energy generally rises across the period, Al is below Mg because its electron is removed from the higher-energy 3p subshell, whereas Mg has a filled 3s² subshell. Thus the required sequence is 496, 737, 577, 786.
